decisions.reason: As a 2023 sensor module tightly aligned with the core modular platform, it remains inexpensive to carry and its continued presence suggests enough unresolved or positive demand to preserve the option.
This industrial voltage input module directly extends the established automation range and, after an additional year without withdrawal, looks like a low-cost platform complement worth retaining.
The solid state relay module fits naturally into the firm's control architecture, so the value of keeping this adjacent option open still outweighs the limited cost of supporting it.

The server room monitoring kit is the most application-specific launch and therefore has the highest exit risk, but because it can be assembled from existing building blocks it is still worth keeping while demand becomes clearer.

As a recent LED control module built on the firm's existing electronics ecosystem, it is sensible to leave it on the market for another year because uncertainty is still high and carrying costs should be modest.

The remote access service for wallboxes supports the firm's strategic push into charging and energy management, so despite some ongoing service cost its strategic option value argues for continuation.
